clans.name: Hearth Clan
clans.blurb: Keepers of the academy's old forge-fires. Their chakra runs hot, and what they hit, burns.

clans.name: Gale Clan
clans.blurb: Runners of the open ridges. Light on their feet and impossible to pin down.

clans.name: Stormvein Clan
clans.blurb: Born where sky meets hill. Their hands are quick and their chakra crackles.

clans.name: Stonewright Clan
clans.blurb: Builders of dams and walls. Slow to anger, slower to fall.

clans.name: Tidebound Clan
clans.blurb: Keepers of the old locks and wells. A calm chakra that never seems to run dry.

clans.name: Wayfarer
clans.blurb: No clan name and no clan limits. Choose your own nature and any eye art, and share your chakra a little thinner: one more Shade Clone.
